scanNote:
WORKBOOK MUNDARIJASI (3-bet). Och pushti fon ustida to'q sariq 'Contents' sarlavhasi. Mashq yo'q.

RO'YXAT (unit - nom - bet):
Unit 1 People around the World p. 4
Unit 2 Night and Day p. 8
Unit 3 Shop till you Drop! p. 12
Unit 4 Days to Remember p. 16
Unit 5 Planning Ahead p. 22
Unit 6 Food, Glorious Food p. 26
Unit 7 Profiles p. 30
Unit 8 A Brush with Danger p. 34
Unit 9 A World of Wonders p. 38
Unit 10 Stick to the Rules! p. 42
Unit 11 Our Precious Planet p. 46
Unit 12 Holidays with a Difference p. 50
Unit 13 Join in the Fun! p. 54
Unit 14 Live and Let Live p. 58
Unit 15 Surf the Net p. 62
Progress Tests p. 67
Video Projects p. 85

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '3'.

⚠ Har unit 4 bet (1-3, 5-15), 4-unit 6 bet (16-21 - o'rtada qo'shimcha), 15-unit 5 bet (62-66).
⚠ Unit nomlari Coursebook bilan BIR XIL, lekin betlar boshqa (Workbook qisqaroq).
⚠ Workbook'da Coursebook'dagi hikoyalar (Story), modul testlari (MSA), Grammar Reference YO'Q; o'rniga 'Progress Tests' (67-bet) va 'Video Projects' (85-bet) bor.
⚠ Skan 78 betdan iborat (pdf 4 = kitob 3-bet), demak oxirgi skan taxminan kitobning 77-beti - 'Video Projects' (85-bet) skanga kirmagan bo'lishi mumkin; davomida tekshiriladi.
⚠ Orqa tomondan (4-bet, 'People around the World') matn ko'chib ko'rinadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - WORKBOOK MUNDARIJASI.

  ⚠ 'contents' = mundarija (ko'plik!).
  'content' (birlik) = mazmun.


TUZILISh:

  15 ta unit - nomlari Coursebook
  bilan BIR XIL. Har unit 4 bet
  (4-unit 6 bet, 15-unit 5 bet).

  ⚠ Coursebook'dagi hikoyalar (Story),
  modul testlari, Grammar Reference
  Workbook'da YO'Q.

  ⚠ O'rniga:
    Progress Tests (67-bet) -
      taraqqiyot testlari (har unitdan
      keyin o'zini tekshirish)
    Video Projects (85-bet) - video
      loyihalar (Enterprise 2 video
      kassetasi uchun topshiriqlar)


⚠ 'PROGRESS':

  = taraqqiyot, o'sish.
  'a progress test' = o'quvchi qancha
  o'sganini tekshiradigan test.
  ⚠ 'to make progress' = o'smoq,
  yaxshilanmoq.


⚠ 'A PROJECT':

  = loyiha. 'a video project' -
  video asosida bajariladigan
  ijodiy topshiriq.


⚠ WORKBOOK BILAN COURSEBOOK
  BETLARI MOS EMAS:

  Coursebook Unit 1 = 6-11-betlar
  Workbook Unit 1 = 4-7-betlar
  ⚠ Ilovada har Workbook beti o'z
  Coursebook unitiga bog'langan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents      = mundarija
  a unit        = bo'lim, unit
  progress      = taraqqiyot
  a test        = test
  a project     = loyiha
  a video       = video

points.noteUz: ⚠ Maqol: boshqalarga ham yashashga imkon ber.

⚠ Har unitdan keyin o'zini tekshirish testlari.
⚠ Coursebook'dagi MSA o'rniga.
